work.author: Giovanni Domenico Mansi and continuators
work.description: The standard eighteenth-century collection of conciliar acts, cited by volume and column. Its volumes are container witnesses: the councils and papal acts printed within them retain their own identity, and Mansi's apparatus records variant recensions and readings.
work.title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova et amplissima collectio
